title: Loading organizations
description: The loading indicator appears while a repository request is pending. TODOs 1-2.

title: Organization list
description: A successful request displays all eight organizations in the phone-width layout. TODO 1.

title: Error feedback
description: Server: error displays a helpful connection message and the Try again action. TODO 4.

title: Retry starts another request
description: Pressing Try again returns the screen to loading. With error mode unchanged, it returns to the error state. TODO 2; E3.

title: Empty repository result
description: Server: empty displays the empty-state message and Refresh action. TODO 5.

title: Search filters the list
description: Typing robotics leaves CICT Robotics Club as the only matching organization. TODO 6; E4.

title: Search with no matches
description: An unmatched query displays a distinct no-results message. TODO 6.

title: Long-press favorite
description: Long-pressing CICT Robotics Club fills its star. The parent screen stores the favorite state. TODO 3; E6.

title: Swipe to hide
description: Swiping Computer Science Circle removes its card and displays CSC hidden with UNDO. TODO 7.

title: Undo restores the card
description: Pressing UNDO restores Computer Science Circle; the Robotics favorite remains selected. TODO 7.

title: Details and missing banner
description: Opening Robotics shows its description, member count, Join button, and placeholder for its null banner URL. E8.

title: Initial form state
description: The untouched form has no validation errors. Submit is disabled while the agreement is unchecked. TODO 14; E11.

title: Validation and digits only
description: Invalid submission shows name, school-email, ID-length and year-level errors. Typing 12ab3 leaves only 123. TODOs 9, 11-12.

title: Reset clears the form
description: Reset clears values and validation errors and restores Events, 3 hours, updates on, and an unchecked agreement.

title: Valid form and changed inputs
description: Demo data is entered; Year 2, Media, 7 hours and updates off are selected. Checking the agreement enables Submit. TODOs 11-14.

title: Registration returned to list
description: Submitting valid data returns to the list, displays Welcome to CRC, James Remegio! and marks Robotics as Joined. TODOs 9-10; E7, E9.

title: Duplicate joining disabled
description: Reopening the joined organization displays a disabled Already a member button. TODO 8.

title: Responsive grid layout
description: At a 1200-pixel viewport width, the same screen displays three columns. The joined state is retained. E5.

title: Network banner loaded
description: Computer Science Circle displays its downloaded banner image and organization details. E8.

title: Failed-image fallback
description: The ITSO image request was deliberately blocked in the browser. The app displays its broken-image placeholder and remains usable. E8.
